title: How AI Actually Calls an API? Tool Calling Explained from Scratch
why_read: An introductory explainer on how LLM tool calling actually works is a decent primer for beginners but covers well-trodden ground for anyone already familiar with the concept.
analysis: This post explains, at a basic level, that when an LLM 'calls a tool' it is really just producing structured text describing a desired function call, which the surrounding application code then executes and feeds back as a result. This is accurate and a genuinely important mental model for newcomers to agentic LLM systems, since misunderstanding this point leads to confusion about what LLMs can and can't do autonomously. However, the content is introductory, covers standard material found in many similar explainers, and the excerpt does not indicate any novel technical insight or implementation detail beyond the basics. It's a fine beginner resource but low novelty for an experienced technical audience.
